digest.component_or_area: transition request value object and close-reason/force plumbing across CLI, library, and MCP
propositions: The close-reason and force admission rule is duplicated across three surfaces (CLI transition.py, library _lib_writes.py, and MCP _mcp_writes.py) with inconsistent behavior: CLI refuses inadmissible reasons while library silently discards them.

The placeholder string literal '(no reason given)' is produced in five code locations across four files without a single authoritative source, and MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter at all.
A bare --force close with an inadmissible reason must remain accepted by normalizing the empty reason to placeholder before the refusal check, not after.
The placeholder must never reach close_disposition.verdict because it would transform an UNJUSTIFIED disposition into a SIGNED one; normalization order relative to refusal checking is load-bearing.

Convergence decision mandates all three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) refuse inadmissible reasons uniformly, and library gains a rejection it previously lacked; this is a sanctioned behavior change requiring test assertion edits.
